urls.title: LinkedIn URLs
urls.description: Public LinkedIn profile (/in/...) or company (/company/...) URLs. Authenticated surfaces (people search, employee lists) are not supported - public pages only.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel pages. LinkedIn is very sensitive - keep at 1-2.

includeRawText.title: Include Raw Text Snippet
includeRawText.description: Add a 1000-character raw text snippet of the page to each dataset item (useful for custom enrichment).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended for LinkedIn.
